newsitem.title: JAPAN: BOJ brings forward release of "tankan", other data.
newsitem.headline: BOJ brings forward release of "tankan", other data.

text.p: The Bank of Japan said on Thursday that it will bring forward the announcement of some major economic data, including its "tankan" short-term corporate sentiment survey, to 8.50 a.m. on November 27 (2350 GMT November 26).
Previously, these announcements were scheduled to start at 10.45 a.m. (0145 GMT) that day.

The data to be released include the corporate service price index, which was previously released at 10.45 a.m. (0145 GMT), and the wholesale price index and money supply, both of which were announced at 11 a.m. (0200 GMT).
